channel.title: OpenAI Research & Releases
channel.description: Latest research papers and model releases from OpenAI

item.title: ATV Big Air Tour turned 3 days of work into 3 hours with ChatGPT
item.description: ATV Big Air Tour uses ChatGPT Work to speed up marketing, merchandising, and more. It even turned merchandise photos into an inventory website in 15 minutes.

item.title: How AI-native companies turn workflows into operating capability
item.description: Basis, Clay, and Exa Labs use AI agents to improve onboarding, account management, and developer integrations. See what enterprise leaders can apply.

item.title: Path to Astra: critical capabilities and frontier safeguards
item.description: Astra is the first OpenAI model to meet the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold under the Preparedness Framework, with stronger safeguards for release.

item.title: Healthcare organizations can now connect EHR and additional industry data to ChatGPT
item.description: ChatGPT can now connect to trusted healthcare data, helping clinicians securely access patient context, medical research, and more.

item.title: How law firm Gilbert + Tobin governs and scales AI with OpenAI
item.description: See how Gilbert + Tobin combines CEO-led commitment, rigorous governance, and human accountability to scale ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex across the firm.

item.title: OpenAI supports California’s bill to advance youth AI safety
item.description: OpenAI supports California SB 1119, advancing strong, age-appropriate AI safeguards for teens while preserving opportunities to learn, create, and explore.

item.title: Polimill builds Japan's next-generation public AI infrastructure
item.description: Polimill uses OpenAI GPT models and Codex to help municipalities search and use administrative knowledge while accelerating development.

item.title: A milestone in expanding access to AI
item.description: ChatGPT Ads reaches $1 billion in annualized revenue run rate and expands globally, supporting broader access to AI through free and affordable options.

item.title: Our decision on Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX
item.description: Our decision to wind down our contract providing OpenAI models to Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX.

item.title: Supporting Thailand’s next generation of AI startups
item.description: OpenAI and Thailand’s MHESI launch an eight-week accelerator helping 10 health, wellness, and education startups turn AI prototypes into trusted products.

item.title: Better answers, broader thinking: What students gain from ChatGPT and critical-thinking training
item.description: A randomized study of more than 1,000 students examines ChatGPT, critical thinking, originality, and student performance on a real-world university assignment.

item.title: Expanding OpenAI’s presence in Brazil
item.description: OpenAI is expanding its presence in Brazil, deepening engagement with developers, businesses, and communities to support AI adoption across the country.

item.title: Learning never stops: How AI makes learning continuous
item.description: OpenAI’s new report explores how students and educators use ChatGPT to make learning more continuous, with support that extends beyond the classroom.

item.title: Bringing ChatGPT for Teachers to more U.S. school districts
item.description: ChatGPT for Teachers is expanding to 55 U.S. school systems, bringing secure AI tools, training, and support to over 100,000 more educators and staff.

item.title: The Hugging Face incident and the road ahead
item.description: OpenAI shares findings from the Hugging Face security incident and the steps we’re taking to strengthen AI model security, monitoring, and alignment.

item.title: How loveholidays is making everyone a builder with Codex
item.description: Discover how loveholidays uses OpenAI Codex to make software development accessible across the business, helping teams turn ideas into products faster.

item.title: The full stack behind abundant intelligence
item.description: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar explains how advances across chips, compute, models, and products compound to deliver more useful intelligence at greater scale and lower cost.

item.title: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference
item.description: Jalapeño is a custom inference chip from OpenAI that delivers faster, more power-efficient AI inference, with higher throughput and lower latency for modern models.

item.title: Disrupting a new covert influence campaign from Russia
item.description: OpenAI banned Russia-origin accounts using AI to promote a fake Israel-based think tank and a “sovereignty” index praising Russia and criticizing the West.

item.title: Introducing the Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex
item.description: Use the Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex to analyze workspace usage, manage members and permissions, adjust limits, and act on admin requests.
